key_result: Homology-guided reconstruction recovered a credible 180-aa W23G protein from the official TP53 retrogene 9 GenBank record.
independent_family_result: W23G recovered in all 18 audited KF records
nomenclature_result: Cross-study TP53RTG9/TP53RTG12 and ENSLAFG00000028299 naming remains inconsistent.
scientific_interpretation: A concrete elephant TP53 retrogene candidate exists, but beneficial MDM2 escape is not yet separated from the distinct Tid1/Bax mitochondrial mechanism.
claim_boundary: W23G correlation does not establish that loss of MDM2 binding causes the published mitochondrial apoptosis phenotype.
